def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    add_on_rate = 0.065
    days_to_maturity = 150
    money_market_year = 360
    bond_equivalent_year = 365

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    holding_period_rate = add_on_rate * days_to_maturity / money_market_year
    purchase_price_fraction = 1 - holding_period_rate
    bond_equivalent_yield = (
        holding_period_rate
        / purchase_price_fraction
        * bond_equivalent_year
        / days_to_maturity
        * 100
    )

    # return answer
    return round(bond_equivalent_yield, 2)
